transcript: hey team I have a fun little announcement which is that I was actually recently accepted into the Outer Critics Circle which if you don't know this is a group of theater critics who review for smaller and less mainstream outlets and I might just be the smallest and least mainstream yet you might recognize the name of the group from the Outer Critic Circle Awards which is kind of one of the main New York theater awards honoring both Off Broadway and Broadway and so that does mean that I get to vote in the next awards and I'm now getting invited to a lot of shows as an awards voter not every show I am still getting some of my own tickets especially for shorter runs or shows that are more off the beaten track I didn't mention it before because I was asked to hold off until some of the odds and ends had been finalized on the OCC side but I've now been given the all clear to talk about it publicly and in case you're curious this really shouldn't change my content at all the only slight difference is that I am now adhering to embargo dates whereas I wasn't before when I was just getting my own tickets through regular public channels but anyway I'm obviously really honored and excited by this obviously I and a lot of content creators like me do exist in this like weird kind of hybrid gray area but whatever label you wanna use like whether you would actually call me a “critic” or not I do think that platforms like this have become an exciting new breeding ground for theater *criticism* at the very least as a concept and a practice and I think that continuing to bridge that gap is gonna be a big part of the future of theater criticism so I'm really honored and excited to be a part of that
